row_fields.title: human title

reachability.chain: concrete chain

row_fields.evidence_bindings: [{kind, file, test (full inventory ID), command, proves, non_executable?}]
row_fields.authored_indices: exact owned authored indices (AUT rows only)

binding_rules.rust-test: test must equal a full name from `cd research/private/remc2-sim-rs && cargo test --workspace --locked -- --list`
binding_rules.unity-test: test must equal a fully-qualified [Test] method parsed from the bound C# source file
binding_rules.python-test: test must equal a module.class.method unittest ID parsed from the bound Python source file
binding_rules.exact_rows: every Exact row must carry >=1 resolving rust-test binding and no non_executable binding
binding_rules.qualification-record: explicitly non-executable; allowed only on non-Exact rows; never counts as proof

schema.classification_rule: Exact requires direct source-to-code evidence plus automated behavioral assertions able to distinguish the specified ordering/branch/state mutation; anything not actually proved is Unproved.
